items.calibration_pH_electrode: Not specified. However, pH measurements and control are discussed in the context of reaction conditions and solvent effects.
items.detected_how: pH was measured/tested during reaction optimization and solvent screening. The pH value was monitored as part of the reaction setup and endpoint, particularly in Table 1 (endpoint pH) and during process development (self-pH control via ethyl acetate hydrolysis).
items.detected_when: pH was measured at the endpoint of reactions (see Table 1) and during the course of the reaction to ensure optimal enzyme activity and process control. The pH was also tested to confirm enzyme activity range (Supporting Information, Figure S1).
items.special_treatment: Self-pH control was achieved by using ethyl acetate as a co-solvent, which hydrolyzes in the presence of NaOH to maintain the pH at 10.5 without the need for additional buffering agents or active pH control equipment. This design minimizes waste and avoids toxic gas release from strong acid pH control.
